engine: Any glTF PBR engine (three.js MeshStandardMaterial, Babylon.js, PlayCanvas, Godot, Unity glTFast)
description: GLB with baked texture maps (basecolor, metallic-roughness, emissive when something glows) in one shared UV layout and one PBR material; painted vertex colours become texture detail. For games that do not use the vertex-colour toon pipeline. Animations as named clips, Y-up metres. Bakes at 1024 px and retries at 512 px if a bake fails.
